summary: Each edition was reviewed independently against all twelve paragraphs of the supplied working Greek. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both retain the conditional promises, emphatic negations, repentance and salvation-with-difficulty assertion, certain explanation of delayed requests, daughter-of-the-devil personification, reflexive “itself,” and closing condition concerning those who think these things. Both follow the servant and contextual repentance policies. The notes distinguish the working readings from stated alternatives without silently substituting or harmonizing them. Acceptance concerns fidelity to the supplied source and adequacy of disclosure; it does not verify unseen editions, manuscript readings, restoration claims, or exhaustive collation.
